#: Strings of MO2 ApI Bridge. Keys are short Latin labels and never change; translate the right-hand sides only. Placeholders like %(mod)s are substituted by the plugin - keep them spelled exactly as they are, or the line is shown raw. Any key starting with # is a note for translators and is ignored. To add a language, copy this file to <code>.json and translate it - nothing else is needed, the plugin picks up whatever lies in this folder.
busy.why: %(app)s is running and MO2 is busy with it. Until that program exits the mod setup cannot be changed: the virtual Data is already mounted into its process, so editing mods, order or plugins now would mean the program sees one setup while the files on disk describe another. Nothing was done. Reads remain fully available.
busy.whyUnknown: MO2 never reported the run (%(run)s) as finished, so its lock is still held - most likely by a process it did not start itself but inherited from one it did. While the lock is held the mod setup cannot be changed. Nothing was done. Reads remain fully available.
config.unreadable: settings: %(path)s not read (%(error)s), using the defaults
config.writeFailed: settings: could not write the defaults to %(path)s: %(error)s
danger.why: Irreversible change to the mod setup. Nothing was done. Read the "Irreversible operations" section of the documentation, understand the consequences, then pass the %(key)s field with the value given there.
dialog.startFailed:
The bridge did NOT start.

%(error)s

Details: %(log)s
dialog.stuck:
MO2 still considers a run active:
%(run)s

While that holds, the bridge refuses to change the mod setup. If the MO2 window is already unlocked and nothing is running, the bookkeeping can be reset.
err.badFlag: %(key)s: expected true or false, not %(value)r - a switch is no place to guess
err.badMode: mode: merge (overlay) or replace (wipe first), not %(mode)s
err.badName: the mod name must be a plain folder name, with no path separators and no colon: %(name)s
err.createFailed: createMod returned nothing - the name is taken or was refused
err.mainThread: MO2's main thread did not answer within %(sec).0f s
err.modExists: mod "%(mod)s" already exists. Nothing is written over it silently: pass mode - merge to overlay the selection, or replace to send the previous contents to the Recycle Bin first
err.needBinary: binary is required - a name REGISTERED in MO2, not a path
err.needButton: button caption required - refusing to click blindly
err.needModOrAll: mod (one or more) or all=1 is required
err.noButton: button "%(button)s" not found in this window
err.orderIncomplete: the list is incomplete or contains unknown plugins - not applied: %(missing)d missing, %(extra)d unknown
err.recycle: could not send to the Recycle Bin: %(path)s; entries already sent before this one: %(done)d
err.windowsOnly: window automation is available on Windows only
init.loaded: plugin loaded, waiting for the user interface
log.nexusDirect: MO2 Nexus bridge unusable (%(error)s), asking the API directly
log.ownRunEnded: our own launch ended, dropping it from the bookkeeping: %(path)s
op.installReplace: installing WITH REPLACE: the mod's previous contents go to the Recycle Bin
plugin.description: Local HTTP bridge to a running MO2: mod list, virtual Data reads, plugin load order, launching tools inside the VFS.
plugin.tooltip: Show the local bridge address and token
setting.enabled: start the bridge together with MO2
start.otherPort: port %(wanted)s was taken - most likely by a second MO2 instance; listening on %(port)s instead, token in %(token)s
upd.badKey: Nexus rejected the key (HTTP %(code)d) - the sweep stopped: with a bad key every further request would fail the same way
upd.current: the downloaded file is the newest in its section
upd.downloadedNotInstalled: a fresh file from %(theirs)s is already in downloads, but the mod was built from an archive dated %(mine)s
upd.hotfix: the Update section holds a hotfix for your version that was not downloaded
upd.networkDown: the connection to Nexus broke: %(fails)d failures in a row, the last one %(error)s; the sweep stopped
upd.newer: the page holds a newer file of the same role
upd.noApiKey: no Nexus API key in the Windows credential store - MO2 is not connected to Nexus (Settings - Nexus - Connect)
upd.noDomain: no Nexus section known for the game %(game)s - MO2 did not name one; add a mapping to nexusDomains in the settings, or there is nobody to ask
upd.noNexusId: the mod has no nexusId - it is not linked to Nexus
upd.otherRole: the main file is in place, but Main gained a newer file of another role
upd.quotaLow: the Nexus daily allowance is running out (%(left)s left) - the sweep stopped so the key keeps working for MO2 itself
upd.rateLimited: the Nexus request limit is used up, retry in %(retry)s - the sweep stopped, since each further attempt would only extend the block
upd.renamed: your file is in Old files and Main holds a newer one under another name
upd.replaced: your file is no longer on the page - the author replaced it; downloaded %(mine)s, Main now holds a file from %(theirs)s
upd.retired: the downloaded file moved to Old files and nothing of the same name replaced it
upd.timeout: Nexus did not answer within %(sec).0f s
upd.unmarked: no file on the page is marked as downloaded
vfs.fallback: virtualFileTree failed (%(error)s), falling back to the breadth-first walk
